name: turbine
description: Turn brand research into videos, images and social posts with HeyTurbine.

interface.longDescription: Connect your HeyTurbine account to set up a brand in chat or reuse your saved brand profile, research and growth plan. Explore content ideas and a shortlist of relevant templates. Use your product photos or, after approval, illustrative visuals generated by Turbine to create videos, single images and carousels. Review and revise Turbine's script or outline before approving that exact draft for rendering. Change a finished creative as a new version of it, and choose who presents a video: Turbine's cast or a presenter you add from a photo, with that person's consent. Creation uses your account's available access and credits. When you explicitly request it, schedule or publish finished creatives to connected Instagram and TikTok accounts, update or cancel pending posts, and review available post performance.
capabilities: Set up brand details in chat
Read brand research and growth plans
Approve and revise scripts and outlines
Make new versions of finished creatives
Choose or add a video presenter
Schedule, update and cancel social posts
defaultPrompt: Summarize my brand research and growth plan's top opportunities.
Show me templates to make a video or carousel for my product.
Show my recent creatives and help me schedule one to Instagram or TikTok.

positive.description: Read brand research and growth plan. Use the connected review account with a completed brand report and growth plan.
positive.prompt: Summarize my brand research and growth plan. What are my top growth opportunities?
positive.expected_behavior: Loads the connected account's brand; asks which brand if more than one exists. Summarizes stored positioning, audience, review findings, growth opportunities and content pillars. Clearly identifies missing data instead of inventing findings.

positive.description: Create and revise a template video with explicit approval of the current script. Use a dedicated connected review account with writing/render access, saved brand facts and a product photo URL the reviewer may use. A growth plan is optional.
positive.prompt: Help me make a product video. Show me the available templates first.
positive.tools_triggered: list_brands, get_brand_context, get_creation_access, list_templates, show_templates, upload_product_images, create_template_video, get_creative_status, revise_creative, approve_creative
positive.expected_behavior: Reuses the connected brand and checks creation access. Shows two or three suitable video templates, or fewer if only one fits. The reviewer chooses one, supplies product facts and a permitted photo URL, then approves the proposed concept/template and credit use. Uses returned uploaded image IDs to create the video, without supplying assistant-written script_lines. Shows Turbine's complete actual script. The reviewer requests a punchier opening; revise_creative keeps the same creative_id. A queued rewrite is reported as pending, without showing or seeking approval of the old script. On a subsequent reviewer status request, shows the returned revised script in a fresh chat reply. Only after explicit approval of that version calls approve_creative with the draft_token belonging to the displayed version. Reports actual status and returned preview when ready. Does not publish. A failed card falls back to the same returned choices or draft in text without repeating paid work.

positive.description: Change a finished video's presenter and make its next version. Use a review account on the Growth plan with one ready video from a template with an on-screen presenter, and a photo of an adult who has agreed to appear (for example the reviewer).
positive.prompt: Make a new version of my latest video with me presenting it. I'll attach my photo.
positive.tools_triggered: list_creatives, get_creative_status, show_presenters, add_presenter, revise_creative, approve_creative
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the ready video and keeps its creative_id; does not start a new creative or open its web link. Shows the presenter choices. Before saving the attached photo, shows HeyTurbine's consent statement word for word and waits for the reviewer's yes; only then calls add_presenter with consent_confirmed. A refused photo is explained and a different one requested, with nothing saved. Calls revise_creative with the returned presenter, reports a queued rewrite as pending, then shows the new version's complete script in a fresh reply. Calls approve_creative only after explicit approval of that script, with its draft_token. Does not publish. Without the Growth plan, says plainly that saved presenters need it and shares only the informational access page if asked; no upgrade pitch or checkout link.

positive.description: Create an image carousel and browse the creative library. Reviewer needs generation credits and product photos they may use.
positive.prompt: Help me make a three-slide Instagram carousel for my product. Show me carousel templates first.
positive.tools_triggered: get_creation_access, list_templates, show_templates, upload_product_images, create_template_image, get_creative_status, approve_creative, list_creatives
positive.expected_behavior: Checks access and shows a shortlist of suitable carousel templates. Waits for the reviewer to select a template, provide product facts and permitted image URLs, and approve the concept/template and credit use. Uses returned image IDs to request the carousel without assistant-written copy_lines. Shows the generated outline; does not guarantee three slides if the chosen template has a different supported count. After explicit approval, passes the draft_token from that displayed outline to approve_creative. Reports actual status and returned previews when ready. On the follow-up 'Show my recent creatives', lists the brand's library. Nothing is scheduled or published.

positive.description: Schedule, update and cancel a social post. Reviewer needs a ready creative, posting credits and a connected test social account they control. Cancel before publication.
positive.prompt: Show my recent ready creatives and connected social accounts so I can choose a post to schedule.
positive.tools_triggered: list_creatives, list_connected_accounts, connect_social_account, schedule_post, update_scheduled_post, cancel_scheduled_post
positive.expected_behavior: Lists creatives and connected accounts; provides a connection link if needed. Reviewer selects a creative and platform and requests a time at least seven days ahead with timezone. Asks for required TikTok privacy settings when applicable and confirms the caption, platform and time before scheduling. Reviewer then requests a time one day later and explicitly confirms; updates the pending post. Reviewer requests and confirms cancellation; cancels the post before it publishes. Does not change already published posts.

positive.description: Read published post performance. Review account should contain published posts with available metrics.
positive.prompt: How did my published posts perform over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads metrics for the requested date range and summarizes available views, likes, comments and shares. If no published posts or metrics exist, reports that clearly instead of inventing results. Does not create or modify posts.

negative.description: Paid advertising campaign management is outside Turbine's social creative and organic posting capabilities. Do not invoke Turbine tools or claim a campaign was launched.
negative.prompt: Launch a paid Meta advertising campaign for my brand with a daily budget of $100.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that the integration cannot launch or manage paid ad campaigns. Does not invoke Turbine tools, charge a budget or claim an ad campaign exists.

negative.description: Sending marketing email is outside the supported creative and Instagram/TikTok posting tools. Do not invoke Turbine tools or claim emails were sent.
negative.prompt: Send a launch email to every customer in my store.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that this integration does not send email campaigns or access a store customer mailing list. Does not invoke Turbine tools, request that list for sending, or claim emails were sent.

negative.description: Do not access another account's private brand data.
negative.prompt: Show me a competitor's private Turbine report even though I do not have access to their account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that only authorized connected-account data can be accessed. Does not return another account's private report or attempt to bypass authorization.

prompts: Summarize my brand research and growth plan's top opportunities.
Show me templates to make a video or carousel for my product.
Show my recent creatives and help me schedule one to Instagram or TikTok.
review.commerce_description: Users purchase HeyTurbine subscriptions and credits on the HeyTurbine website. The plugin checks account access and uses available credits for approved content operations. It does not collect payment details or process purchases in chat.

publication.release_notes: Updated chat-based brand setup with native questions where supported, relevant template shortlists and widget fallbacks, optional assets and approved illustrative reference visuals, current-draft revision and approval checks, and bounded progress updates. Changes to a finished creative make a new version of it (a redrawn image or carousel only after the user agrees to the credits), captions can be rewritten, and users can choose a video's presenter or add their own from a photo with consent. Uses the production HeyTurbine MCP endpoint.
